class NewtonFullLesson(Scene):
    FONT = 'Noto Sans Bengali'
    INK = '#0f172a'
    SUB = '#334155'
    FC = '#b91c1c'
    MC = '#1d4ed8'
    AC = '#15803d'
    LINE = '#94a3b8'
    GOLD = '#f59e0b'
    WARM = '#b45309'

    def txt(self, s, size=20, color=None):
        return Text(s, font=self.FONT, font_size=size, color=color or self.INK)

    def backdrop(self):
        self.plane = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-8, 8, 1],
            y_range=[-5, 5, 1],
            background_line_style={'stroke_color': '#cbd5e1', 'stroke_width': 1, 'stroke_opacity': 0.35},
            faded_line_style={'stroke_opacity': 0},
            axis_config={'stroke_opacity': 0}
        )
        self.add(self.plane)

    def clear_stage(self):
        self.play(*[FadeOut(m) for m in self.mobjects if m is not self.plane], run_time=1)

    def heading(self, s, size=26):
        t = self.txt(s, size).to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)
        bar = Line(t.get_left(), t.get_right(), color=self.GOLD, stroke_width=4).next_to(t, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        return VGroup(t, bar)

    def note(self, s, size=18):
        t = self.txt(s, size)
        box = RoundedRectangle(width=t.width + 0.6, height=t.height + 0.4, corner_radius=0.15, color=self.GOLD, fill_color='#fffbeb', fill_opacity=0.95, stroke_width=2.5)
        t.move_to(box)
        return VGroup(box, t).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.25)

    def chip(self, s, color):
        t = self.txt(s, 18, color)
        box = RoundedRectangle(width=t.width + 0.6, height=0.6, corner_radius=0.3, color=color, fill_color='#ffffff', fill_opacity=0.95, stroke_width=2.5)
        t.move_to(box)
        return VGroup(box, t)

    def card(self, title, formula, color):
        t = self.txt(title, 22)
        f = MathTex(formula, font_size=44, color=self.INK)
        content = VGroup(t, f).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.35)
        box = RoundedRectangle(width=6.0, height=content.height + 0.7, corner_radius=0.2, color=color, fill_color='#ffffff', fill_opacity=0.92, stroke_width=3)
        content.move_to(box)
        return VGroup(box, content)

    def cart(self, w, h, fill, mass, track_y, x0):
        body = RoundedRectangle(width=w, height=h, corner_radius=0.12, color=self.MC, fill_color=fill, fill_opacity=0.75, stroke_width=3)
        wheels = VGroup(*[VGroup(Circle(radius=0.14, color=self.INK, fill_color='#475569', fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=2), Dot(radius=0.04, color='#e2e8f0')) for _ in range(2)])
        wheels[0].move_to(body.get_corner(DL) + RIGHT * 0.3)
        wheels[1].move_to(body.get_corner(DR) + LEFT * 0.3)
        label = self.txt(mass, 15).move_to(body)
        group = VGroup(body, wheels, label)
        group.move_to([x0, track_y + (h + 0.14) / 2, 0])
        return group

    def lane(self, y, w, h, fill, mass, force, accel, force_text, calc, x0=-4.4):
        track = Line(LEFT * 6.8, RIGHT * 6.8, color=self.LINE, stroke_width=3).shift(UP * y)
        ticks = VGroup(*[Line(UP * 0.07, DOWN * 0.07, color=self.LINE, stroke_width=2).move_to([x, y, 0]) for x in np.arange(-6.0, 6.5, 1.0)])
        cart = self.cart(w, h, fill, mass, y, x0)
        ghost = cart.copy().set_opacity(0.18)
        anchor = cart[0].get_left()
        arrow = Arrow(anchor + LEFT * (0.4 + 0.04 * force), anchor, buff=0, color=self.FC, stroke_width=3 + force / 8, max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.4)
        arrow_lbl = self.txt(force_text, 14, self.FC).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.08)
        calc_m = MathTex(calc, font_size=26, color=self.AC).next_to(cart, UP, buff=0.3)
        mover = VGroup(cart, arrow, arrow_lbl, calc_m)
        speed = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=1, font_size=30, color=self.AC)
        readout = VGroup(MathTex('v =', font_size=30, color=self.AC), speed, MathTex(r'\text{ m/s}', font_size=30, color=self.AC)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.12).move_to([5.1, y - 0.5, 0])
        return {'static': VGroup(track, ticks), 'ghost': ghost, 'mover': mover, 'readout': readout, 'speed': speed, 'accel': accel, 'x0': x0, 'y': y}

    def mover_updater(self, t, accel):
        def update(m):
            d = 0.5 * accel * t.get_value() ** 2 / 12
            m.shift(RIGHT * (d - m.disp))
            m.disp = d
        return update

    def race(self, lanes, T):
        t = ValueTracker(0)
        clock_dec = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=1, font_size=30, color=self.INK)
        clock = VGroup(MathTex('t =', font_size=30, color=self.INK), clock_dec, MathTex(r'\text{ s}', font_size=30, color=self.INK)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.12).to_corner(UR, buff=0.4).shift(DOWN * 0.7)
        clock_dec.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(t.get_value()))
        for ln in lanes:
            ln['mover'].disp = 0
            ln['upd'] = self.mover_updater(t, ln['accel'])
            ln['mover'].add_updater(ln['upd'])
            ln['speed'].add_updater(lambda d, a=ln['accel']: d.set_value(a * t.get_value()))
        self.play(FadeIn(clock), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(t.animate.set_value(T), run_time=T, rate_func=linear)
        clock_dec.clear_updaters()
        for ln in lanes:
            ln['mover'].remove_updater(ln['upd'])
            ln['speed'].clear_updaters()
        self.wait(0.8)
        marks = []
        for ln in lanes:
            d = 0.5 * ln['accel'] * T ** 2 / 12
            span = Line([ln['x0'], ln['y'] - 0.12, 0], [ln['x0'] + d, ln['y'] - 0.12, 0])
            br = Brace(span, DOWN, buff=0.02, color=self.GOLD)
            lb = self.txt('৩ সেকেন্ডে দূরত্ব', 14, self.WARM).next_to(br, DOWN, buff=0.06)
            marks.append(VGroup(br, lb))
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m, shift=UP * 0.1) for m in marks], lag_ratio=0.3), run_time=1.5)

    def experiment(self, title, sub, specs, relation, obs, T=3.0):
        head = self.heading(title, 24)
        subt = self.txt(sub, 18, self.FC).next_to(head, DOWN, buff=0.15)
        self.play(Write(head[0]), GrowFromCenter(head[1]), FadeIn(subt), run_time=1.2)
        lanes = [self.lane(**s) for s in specs]
        anims = []
        for ln in lanes:
            anims += [FadeIn(ln['static']), FadeIn(ln['ghost']), FadeIn(ln['mover'], shift=RIGHT * 0.3), FadeIn(ln['readout'])]
        self.play(LaggedStart(*anims, lag_ratio=0.12), run_time=2.2)
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.race(lanes, T)
        rel = MathTex(relation, font_size=34, color=self.INK).move_to([5.0, -0.9, 0])
        rel_box = SurroundingRectangle(rel, color=self.GOLD, buff=0.18, stroke_width=2.5)
        self.play(Create(rel_box), Write(rel), run_time=1.2)
        note = self.note(obs)
        self.play(Create(note[0]), Write(note[1]), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(3)
        self.clear_stage()

    def intro(self):
        head = self.heading('নিউটনের গতির দ্বিতীয় সূত্র', 34)
        f = MathTex('F', font_size=64, color=self.FC)
        eq = MathTex('=', font_size=64, color=self.INK)
        ma = VGroup(MathTex('m', font_size=64, color=self.MC), MathTex('a', font_size=64, color=self.AC)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.06)
        eq_f = VGroup(f, eq, ma).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.25).next_to(head, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        desc = self.txt('বস্তুর ত্বরণ প্রযুক্ত বলের সমানুপাতিক এবং ভরের ব্যস্তানুপাতিক', 20, self.SUB).next_to(eq_f, DOWN, buff=0.35)
        num = MathTex('F', font_size=64, color=self.FC)
        den = MathTex('m', font_size=64, color=self.MC)
        bar = Line(LEFT * 0.45, RIGHT * 0.45, color=self.INK, stroke_width=4)
        frac = VGroup(num, bar, den).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.12)
        eq_a = VGroup(MathTex('a', font_size=64, color=self.AC), MathTex('=', font_size=64, color=self.INK), frac).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3).next_to(desc, DOWN, buff=0.45)
        chips = VGroup(self.chip('F = বল (নিউটন)', self.FC), self.chip('m = ভর (কেজি)', self.MC), self.chip('a = ত্বরণ (মি/সে²)', self.AC)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.4).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(Write(head[0]), GrowFromCenter(head[1]), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Write(eq_f), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(desc, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(eq_f, eq_a), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c, shift=UP * 0.2) for c in chips], lag_ratio=0.3), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Indicate(eq_f, color=self.GOLD, scale_factor=1.1))
        self.wait(2.5)
        self.clear_stage()

    def summary(self):
        head = self.heading('চূড়ান্ত সারসংক্ষেপ: F = ma', 30)
        c1 = self.card('১. বল বাড়লে ত্বরণ বাড়ে', r'a \propto F', self.FC)
        c2 = self.card('২. ভর বাড়লে ত্বরণ কমে', r'a \propto \frac{1}{m}', self.MC)
        cards = VGroup(c1, c2).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).next_to(head, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        l0 = self.txt('বাস্তব উদাহরণ', 20, self.WARM)
        l1 = self.txt('খালি ভ্যানগাড়ি ধাক্কা দেওয়া সহজ,', 18)
        l2 = self.txt('কিন্তু মালামাল ভর্তি ভ্যানে জড়তা বেশি থাকায় গতি বাড়ানো কঠিন!', 18)
        lines = VGroup(l0, l1, l2).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        ex_box = RoundedRectangle(width=lines.width + 0.8, height=lines.height + 0.6, corner_radius=0.2, color=self.WARM, fill_color='#fffbeb', fill_opacity=0.95, stroke_width=2.5)
        lines.move_to(ex_box)
        example = VGroup(ex_box, lines).next_to(cards, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(head[0]), GrowFromCenter(head[1]), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(c1, shift=RIGHT * 0.3), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(c2, shift=LEFT * 0.3), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(Create(ex_box), Write(lines), run_time=2)
        self.play(Indicate(cards, color=self.GOLD, scale_factor=1.04))
        self.wait(4)

    def construct(self):
        self.backdrop()
        self.intro()
        self.experiment(
            'পরীক্ষা ১: একই বল (F), কিন্তু ভিন্ন ভর (m)',
            'F = ২০ N (উভয় ক্ষেত্রে অপরিবর্তিত)',
            [
                {'y': 0.5, 'w': 0.9, 'h': 0.8, 'fill': '#93c5fd', 'mass': '১ কেজি', 'force': 20, 'accel': 20, 'force_text': 'F = ২০ N', 'calc': r'a_1 = \frac{20}{1} = 20 \text{ m/s}^2'},
                {'y': -1.9, 'w': 1.7, 'h': 0.9, 'fill': '#60a5fa', 'mass': '৪ কেজি', 'force': 20, 'accel': 5, 'force_text': 'F = ২০ N', 'calc': r'a_2 = \frac{20}{4} = 5 \text{ m/s}^2'},
            ],
            r'm \times 4 \;\Rightarrow\; a \div 4',
            'পর্যবেক্ষণ: ভর বেশি হলে একই বল প্রয়োগেও ত্বরণ অনেক কমে যায়!',
        )
        self.experiment(
            'পরীক্ষা ২: একই ভর (m = ২ কেজি), কিন্তু ভিন্ন বল (F)',
            'm = ২ কেজি (উভয় ক্ষেত্রে অপরিবর্তিত)',
            [
                {'y': 0.5, 'w': 1.1, 'h': 0.9, 'fill': '#93c5fd', 'mass': '২ কেজি', 'force': 10, 'accel': 5, 'force_text': 'কম বল: ১০ N', 'calc': r'a_1 = \frac{10}{2} = 5 \text{ m/s}^2'},
                {'y': -1.9, 'w': 1.1, 'h': 0.9, 'fill': '#93c5fd', 'mass': '২ কেজি', 'force': 30, 'accel': 15, 'force_text': 'বেশি বল: ৩০ N', 'calc': r'a_2 = \frac{30}{2} = 15 \text{ m/s}^2'},
            ],
            r'F \times 3 \;\Rightarrow\; a \times 3',
            'পর্যবেক্ষণ: ভর স্থির থাকলে বল যত বাড়ানো হয়, ত্বরণ ঠিক তত গুণ বৃদ্ধি পায়!',
        )
        self.summary()
